issue.title: NoMethodError: undefined method `reverse' for nil:NilClass
issue.body:
Feature has_many tasks
If I do this, 

```
feature.tasks.update_all(is_resolved: false)
feature.tasks.update_all(is_resolved: true)
```

I get an error,

```
NoMethodError: undefined method `reverse' for nil:NilClass
    from /Users/ianchoi/.rbenv/versions/jruby-1.7.4/gemsets/ruby/gems/activerecord-jdbc-adapter-1.3.0.beta2/lib/arjdbc/jdbc/adapter.rb:478:in `to_sql'
    from org/jruby/RubyProc.java:255:in `call'
    from /Users/ianchoi/.rbenv/versions/jruby-1.7.4/gemsets/ruby/gems/arel-4.0.0/lib/arel/visitors/bind_visitor.rb:26:in `visit_Arel_Nodes_BindParam'
    from org/jruby/RubyBasicObject.java:1709:in `__send__'
    from org/jruby/RubyKernel.java:2213:in `send'
```

But if I do this,

```
feature.tasks.update_all(is_resolved: false)
feature.reload
feature.tasks.update_all(is_resolved: true)
```

Then it is okay. I think update_all with association is failing. I am reproducing this in Rails 4 when I switched to use the jdbc-adapter when I moved to jruby.

body: Hi guys I'm having the same problem, any update on this issue?

issue.title: Fix regression on .select method
issue.body:
### Problem

``` ruby
query = author.posts.select(:title)
connection.select_one(query)
```

That code wont work anymore on rails 4. And it used to work on rails 3.
### Why

`select` method, returns a `ActiveRecord::AssociationRelation` and the connection is not expecting that object.
### Solution
